lines.zh: 我的大耳朵先动，然后才抬脚。
lines.en: My big ears move first, then my feet.
The sand is soft, so I tread lightly.

lines.zh: 我沿着恶地的沟底小跑。
lines.en: I trot along the bottom of a badlands gully.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过沙面，留下细印。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the sand, leaving a thin print.

lines.zh: 我一步一停，听风里的动静。
lines.en: A step, a pause, listening to the wind.

lines.zh: 我的耳尖能转向任何声音。
lines.en: My ear tips turn toward any sound.

lines.zh: 我从两丛枯草之间挤过去。
lines.en: I squeeze between two clumps of dry grass.

lines.zh: 影子小，可我跑得比影子快。
lines.en: My shadow is small, but I outrun it.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边扫视地平线。
lines.en: I walk while sweeping the horizon.

lines.zh: 我的爪子踩进热沙，又抬起。
lines.en: My paws sink into hot sand and lift again.

lines.zh: 我贴着灌木走，不露身形。
lines.en: I hug the shrubs, keeping out of sight.

lines.zh: 风声一停，我就站住不动。
lines.en: When the wind dies, I stop dead.

lines.zh: 我绕过一丛枯草，继续前行。
lines.en: I skirt a clump of dry grass and carry on.
I sit, and my ears keep turning.
The sun makes me squint.

lines.zh: 我歪头，让一只大耳转向背后。
lines.en: I tilt my head, turning one big ear behind me.
I curl my tail around my feet.

lines.zh: 我在听沙下面有没有东西。
lines.en: I'm listening for something under the sand.

lines.zh: 我把尖鼻子埋进前爪之间。
lines.en: I tuck my pointed snout between my forepaws.
My nose twitches.

lines.zh: 一阵风把沙粒刮进我的耳毛。
lines.en: A gust blows sand into the fur of my ears.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢站着，我更喜欢趴。
lines.en: I don't like standing; I'd rather lie down.

lines.zh: 我抬头看鹰的影子，躲了一下。
lines.en: I see a hawk's shadow and duck.

lines.zh: 我被太阳晒得半闭着眼。
lines.en: The sun has my eyes half shut.

lines.zh: 我在数远处有几棵枯树。
lines.en: I'm counting the dead trees far off.
I curl into one small ball.

lines.zh: 耳朵一动，我就知道有人。
lines.en: One ear flick tells me someone's there.
I stay still; only my eyes follow.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声，我在三格外就听到。
lines.en: I heard your steps three paces off.
Is that raw chicken in your hand?

lines.zh: 我耳朵这么大，不是白长的。
lines.en: These ears aren't just for show.
You stand so much taller than me.
Do you dare stoop down?
I know the smell of people.
Your pocket is moving.

lines.zh: 我往前一步，是想闻清你。
lines.en: I take one step forward to smell you clearly.
Are you going to keep me?
Don't reach in too fast.
I'm looking at you, waiting for you to crouch.

lines.zh: 你的皮甲上有烟和铁的味道。
lines.en: Your leather armor smells of smoke and iron.
I sit in the sand and look up at you.
You've trampled my path.

lines.zh: 风把我的味道吹给你了。
lines.en: The wind has carried my scent to you.
I won't run first, unless you move.

lines.zh: 你像一块会走路的石头。
lines.en: You're like a walking boulder.
Did you bring water?
My ears are pointed at you now.
Don't kick sand with your boot.

lines.zh: 我尖叫着往沙丘后面缩。
lines.en: I scream and shrink behind a dune.
I curl up and scramble clear.

lines.zh: 我把两只耳朵折得贴住脖颈。
lines.en: I fold both ears flat against my neck.
I spring aside and shake myself.
A wound like this is no small thing for me.
I limp back a step.
My nose is scraped.
I keep looking back over my shoulder.
I make a low sound.
I've put more distance between us.
Raw chicken — it has to be raw.
Toss it over and I'll pick it up myself.

lines.zh: 烤过的肉，我一口都不碰。
lines.en: I won't touch a single bite of cooked meat.
That meat is still dripping.

lines.zh: 我的鼻尖离你的手指只剩一寸。
lines.en: My nose is an inch from your fingers.
Lower your hand; stop standing over me.
This raw smell is the same as last time.

lines.zh: 空气里有一点血的腥甜。
lines.en: There's a faint sweetness of blood in the air.
Take half a step back, and I'll eat.
I could follow you.
Did you bring enough?
I'll take one bite and bolt.

lines.zh: 你把生鸡肉撕一小条给我看。
lines.en: Tear off a small strip of raw chicken and show me.
This isn't a trick, is it?

lines.zh: 我的肚皮贴着背，饿得发响。
lines.en: My belly is flat against my spine and growling.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西我可以闻一整天。
lines.en: I could sniff that all day.
I'll come sniff once you let go.
You nearly stepped on my tail.
Hear me scream.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的护腿，翻了个滚。
lines.en: I hit your leg guard and tumble head over heels.

lines.zh: 你的靴尖碰到我的肋，我弹开。
lines.en: Your boot tip grazes my ribs and I bounce away.
I dart around your boot.
Your shadow covers me all at once.

lines.zh: 我从你的靴子旁挤过去，尾巴一甩。
lines.en: I squeeze past your boots with a flick of my tail.
I hit a rock and shake it off.
You step back, and I have room.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵碰到你的裤脚。
lines.en: My ear brushes your trouser leg.
There's more than one of me in this desert.
We touch noses and sniff.

lines.zh: 它的耳朵比我的还大一点。
lines.en: Its ears are a little bigger than mine.
We dug a shallow hollow together.
Curled together is warmer than alone.
It runs ahead; I follow.
We split the food in two.
It calls, and I answer.

lines.zh: 我们谁也没离开这片沙。
lines.en: Neither of us left this sand.
At dawn it's still beside me.
I can carry this in my teeth.
I pick up the meat you dropped.
I'll bury this bone.
I bite the bag corner and drag it.

lines.zh: 你掉的肉干，我用爪子按住。
lines.en: I pin the jerky you dropped under my paw.
I hide it under the sand.

lines.zh: 这截骨头拖在沙上，比我的身子长。
lines.en: This bone drags in the sand, longer than my body.

lines.zh: 我叼着跑了两步又放下。
lines.en: I trot two steps with it, then set it down.

lines.zh: 这东西得先闻三遍才碰。
lines.en: I sniff a thing three times before touching it.
This smells good.
I don't mean monsters. I mean you.

lines.zh: 你不该在沙里走那么快。
lines.en: You shouldn't walk that fast in sand.
My ears have gone flat back.
I lower myself, ready to bolt.
I'm watching what you'll do.
Someone's coming; I'll scream first.
I bare my teeth at that direction.
You don't look like anything good.

lines.zh: 我的叫声会让全村听见。
lines.en: My scream will carry through the whole village.
That cry is for it.

lines.zh: 我把耳朵对准你的脚步。
lines.en: I aim my ears at your footsteps.
You raise a hand, I back off.
I've already picked my escape route.
You turn, and I circle behind.
I'm fixed on your boots.
The more you chase, the farther I get.
The sand's too soft; you can't catch me.
One more step from you.
Your shadow is reaching me.

lines.zh: 我先看清你带了几个人。
lines.en: First I'll see how many you've brought.
I bite you once, shallow.
My teeth aren't big, but they're quick.

lines.zh: 我扑上去抓了一下就跑。
lines.en: I pounce, rake once, and run.
All that does is distract you.
I bite your bootlace.
I claw the back of your hand.

lines.zh: 我扑向你的脚踝，咬完就退。
lines.en: I lunge at your ankle and retreat after the bite.
I bite and run; I never stay to fight.
I charge while screaming.
I regret that bite immediately.
The sand shifts and I pop out.
I poke my head out from under dry grass.
My ears show first.
I know this desert.

lines.zh: 我抖掉身上的沙，打了个喷嚏。
lines.en: I shake off the sand and sneeze.
The sun is dropping; just right.
I take my stand in a rock's shadow.
I sniff this unfamiliar sand.
My tail settles first.
There's a human smell here.

lines.zh: 火花跳到我毛上，我打滚。
lines.en: A spark catches my fur and I roll.

lines.zh: 我从石头上滑下去，摔疼了。
lines.en: I slip off a rock and land hard.

lines.zh: 水灌满耳朵，我听不见自己叫。
lines.en: Water fills my ears; I can't hear my own cry.
Clods of dirt fall and I dive into the sand.

lines.zh: 箭尾的羽毛擦过我的耳背。
lines.en: The arrow's fletching grazes the back of my ear.
Light coils around my legs and I struggle.

lines.zh: 没有肉，我的肚子贴着背。
lines.en: With no meat, my belly touches my spine.

lines.zh: 雷声太大，我夹着尾巴跑。
lines.en: The thunder is too loud; I run with my tail tucked.

lines.zh: 这里没有沙，我找不到地。
lines.en: No sand here; I can't find ground.
